ascend_skill.desc:
After obtaining Kotone Shiomi, during battle, for every Strategist present (including Wonder's currently equipped Persona), increase party's final damage amplification by 1% (takes effect even when Kotone Shiomi is not in battle). At the start of battle, grant the Arcana Link state to the Sweeper or Assassin ally with the highest Attack. At the start of Kotone Shiomi's turn, she can reselect the target of Arcana Link. Multiple allies cannot be in the Arcana Link state at the same time.
When the ally in the Arcana Link state uses a skill, or when Kotone Shiomi uses a skill on the ally in the Arcana Link state, increase the target's Lunar Bond (max 10). Also, gain the following effects based on current Lunar Bond.
1: Increase Attack by 50%.
5: Increase pierce rate by 15%.
10: Increase critical damage by 50%.
When reselecting the target of Arcana Link, Lunar Bond is reset.
Also, Kotone Shiomi can activate Go for Broke once per battle. When activated, she enters the Fortune state.
ascend_skill.name: Moment of Truth

ascend_skill.desc:
When entering the Fortune state, immediately activate Highlight once without spending the Highlight gauge.
When granting an ally the Arcana Link state, grant them 1 permanent Powerful Bond stack while they are in the Arcana Link state, and set Lunar Bond to 5.
If an ally has 3 Powerful Bond stacks after receiving Lyre's Melody, increase the target's critical damage by 30% more for 5 turns.
ascend_skill.name: Echoing Strings

ascend_skill.desc: When in the Fortune state, extend the duration of all effects granted by Kotone Shiomi's skills and Highlight by 1 more turn. Also, the copy multiplier when using Lunar Phaseshift is multiplied by 1.25.
ascend_skill.name: Team Mom

ascend_skill.desc: Increase the skill levels of Lyre's Melody and Combat Tactics.
ascend_skill.name: Full Moon Night

ascend_skill.desc: Highlight Enhanced: Increase party's damage by 25% for 2 turns.
ascend_skill.name: Eternal Bonds

ascend_skill.desc: Increase the skill levels of Burning Moon's Cry and Lunar Phaseshift.
ascend_skill.name: Unquenchable Flames

ascend_skill.desc:
Go for Broke can be used 1 more time.
When using Lunar Phaseshift on allies other than Wonder, if Wonder is not in the Arcana Link state, also copy certain buffs' effects granted by Wonder to the Arcana Link ally with a copy multiplier of their original effectiveness. These effects last for 1 turn, and certain effects cannot be copied.
ascend_skill.name: Song of the Soul

highlight_skill.desc: Increase party's critical damage by 19.5%/21.5%/20.7%/22.7%, and also increase Attack of the ally in the Arcana Link state by 24.4%/26.9%/25.9%/28.4% for 2 turns. When in the Fortune state, extend duration by 2 turns.
highlight_skill.name: Highlight

normal_skill.desc:
Based on Kotone Shiomi's Attack (up to 4684/5164/4972/5452), increase 1 ally's critical damage by up to 19.5%/21.5%/20.7%/22.7% for 3 turns. Stacks up to 3 times.
If the main target is in the Arcana Link state, grant 1 Powerful Bond stack (3 turns, stacks up to 3 times). When Kotone Shiomi is present, based on the total number of stacks, grant the following effects to the target.
1: Increase Attack by 39.0%/43.0%/41.4%/45.4%.
2: Increase pierce rate by 14.6%/16.1%/15.5%/17.0%.
3: Increase Final Damage Amplification by 4.9%/5.4%/5.2%/5.7%.
When in the Fortune state, extend this skill's effect duration by 2 turns.
normal_skill.name: Lyre's Melody

normal_skill.desc:
Deal Fire damage to all foes equal to 53.9%/59.4%/57.2%/62.7% of Attack (3 hits). If the enemy count is reduced below 5, increase damage by 25% per reduced foe.
If the ally in the Arcana Link state has 3 Powerful Bonds, based on Kotone Shiomi's Attack (up to 4684/5164/4972/5452), increase all foes' damage taken by up to 29.3%/32.3%/31.1%/34.1% for 1 turn.
When in the Fortune state, increase this skill's damage by 292.8%/322.8%/310.8%/340.8% more and extend duration by 2 turns. Also, decrease Down Points of all targets that take damage by 2/2/2/2 regardless of affinities.
normal_skill.name: Burning Moon's Cry

normal_skill.desc:
Based on Kotone Shiomi's Attack (up to 4684/5164/4972/5452), increase party's Attack by up to 29.3%/32.3%/31.1%/34.1% for 1 turn.
If the main target is an ally without the Arcana Link state (excluding Kotone Shiomi), copy certain buffs' effects granted by the target to the Arcana Link ally with a 30.0%/30.0%/30.0%/30.0% copy multiplier of their original effectiveness. These effects last for 1 turn, and certain effects cannot be copied.
When in the Fortune state, extend this skill's effect duration by 1 turn.
Cooldown Time: 2 turns (does not count extra actions).
normal_skill.name: Lunar Phaseshift

passive_skill.desc: When granting buffs to allies, increase the main target's Attack by 9.0% for 3 turns. Stacks up to 3 times.
passive_skill.name: Leader's Guidance

passive_skill.desc: When Powerful Bond is granted, increase the target's pierce rate by 12.0% for 2 turns.
passive_skill.name: Clean Sweep
